posts.cooked:
Mint!

At least this is one of the better teams that can handle Spite.

As long as you get Stun Bolt and Smoke Bombs out in time it shouldn't be too bad. Fortitude and Inspiring Prescence come quickly enough as well.

Lead from the Front and Next Evolution are the other good Legacy shenanigans that work well vs. Spite.

Once you stop taking damage from Spite the win becomes inevitable.

For the record I saved 3 bystanders! (including the Sidekick!)

posts.name: Arcanist Lupus
posts.cooked:
Mint, with everyone alive. (Wraith 8, Legacy 3, AZ fluctuating rapidly)

Lead from the Front + Smoke Bombs to funnel all the damage to AZ, who could heal everything with his +3 cold damage.  A few Stun Bolts, Next Evolution set to Toxic (probably not necessary, but it made me feel better) and a Legacy Ring so that Legacy could shield and galvanize at the same time.

 

Once AZ brought Spite down to 3, I held off on killing him, so that I could let Wraith deal the finishing blow.  Then he got crushed by Falling Statuary instead, which I decided was good enough.  Or at least, flat enough.

posts.name: schadkehnfreude
posts.cooked:
LewdDolphin21:

Mint, thanks to double Stun Bolt, Next Evolution, and Lead from the Front, along with a bunch of Absolute Zero shenanigans. 'twas pretty fun, I have to say (though I generally don't like games against Spite).

Yeah, I get that a lot too - if I'm the game leader I usually ask if anyone has a preference for villain - most of the time no one does but I've gotten more "No Spite, please" than anyone else with only Miss Info being even close.  

The deck-milling drug adds some interesting variance to this one and it can get hairy, especially if you don't do Absolute Zero math correctly.  The two mistakes I made but overcame were a) playing Wraith's Combat Stance first turn, thinking it'd be helpful.  It's not - Spite heals away the crackback damage in phase 1 and in phase 2 if you're playing your cards right, Wraith shouldn't be taking damage at all - she can hardly afford to, and b) getting cute with Hoarfire one turn to the point where I couldn't use Thermal Shockwave - not healing that turn had a snowball effect (pardon the pun) of getting Zero's HP dangerously low. On my second play-through, I didn't get either Fortitude or Thermal Shockwave but it really feels like only two cards that really matter in this one-shot are  Stun Bolt and Smoke Bombs.
